chunks: The day their tongues and hands and feet bear witness to what they had done,
ai.seo_question: What do the body parts testify against humans on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the concept of 'Shahadat al-Jawarih' (testimony of the limbs), illustrating that the body itself becomes a witness to the soul's intent and actions. It underscores the comprehensive nature of divine justice, where every physical movement serves as irrefutable evidence against the individual on the Day of Judgment.
